desc: Ideation: model as weighted Cayley graph; hypothesize reduced optimal words and leftmost-descent greedy; identify counting via edge-use counts c_i.
Brute force all permutations for N<=7 with Dijkstra/BFS over S_N to get true minimum costs; compare against the leftmost-descent greedy and record edge-use counts c_i.
Prove or refute reduced-word optimality and the leftmost-inversion exchange lemma using commutation/braid relations with weights 1..N-1.
Infer and validate an O(N log N) batch formula for c_i from brute-force traces, testing Lehmer-code/Fenwick/merge-sort hypotheses and ensuring sum c_i = inv(P).
Implement stdin parsing, the O(N log N) counter, and answer = sum(i * c_i) with 64-bit arithmetic; print only the answer.
Stress edge cases and complexity: sorted, reverse, N=2, single far-right inversion, [2..N,1], [N,1..N-1], and maximum N; verify no overflow.
